description: Successful identification of moral values from positions

request.systemPrompt:
You are an expert in moral psychology and value analysis. Identify the core values underlying different positions.
Focus on fundamental values like: fairness, liberty, loyalty, authority, sanctity, care, harm prevention, etc.
Return ONLY a JSON array of values: ["value1", "value2", "value3"]

messages.content:
Identify the underlying values in these positions:

- We must protect individual freedom above all else
- Community welfare should come before personal gain
- Traditional institutions deserve respect
